subject: Launchboard: scheduling & attendee roll call for intro session
content:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@scalingly.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchboard intro — proposed timing and attendees

Hi Logan / Rishi,

Thanks for the trial access so far — excited to get the team formally onboarded. Would like to schedule an introductory launch session with our product + infra teams to align on scope, success metrics and next steps. Below are our preferences: 

- Week of Sept 20 — prefer morning PT (10:00–11:30 PT window)
- Approx 60–75 minutes
- High-level agenda: introductions, success criteria, data/workflow handoff, integration checklist, next milestones

Tentative attendees from Scalingly: Olivia Park (Prod Lead), Samir Khan (Procurement), Leila Torres (SRE). We also plan to have a short procurement-only follow-up to cover the contract items — Samir will coordinate.

Attached: Scalingly_Onboarding_Deck_v0.9.pdf (internal primer).

Are any of the dates/times below possible for you? If so, can you send one confirmed calendar invite with dial-in?

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Product, Scalingly
[Attachment: Scalingly_Onboarding_Deck_v0.9.pdf]

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia@scalingly.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchboard intro — proposed timing and attendees

Hi Olivia — great to hear from you, welcome aboard.

We can do any morning that week. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue, Sept 21, 10:00–11:00
- Wed, Sept 22, 09:30–10:30

Draft agenda (60 mins):
1) 10 min introductions + roles
2) 15 min overview of initial success metrics & Milestones (you)
3) 20 min integration checklist (data shapes, network, auth) — Rishi + Ava
4) 10 min ops + handoffs (runbooks, SLAs)
5) 5 min next steps / owners

Proposed internal attendees (can expand):
- Logan Wright (AM, Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra (Customer Success)
- Ava Chen (Solutions Engineer)

I attached a kickoff agenda draft and can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot and final attendee list. Also looping in Rishi for technical intake and Markus for contracting/discount discussion if that becomes relevant.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Kickoff_Agenda_Draft.pdf]

Thanks Olivia / Logan — Rishi here. Per the agenda, I want to make sure we include a short demo of the integration checklist and a quick look at observability/playbook items so your SREs know what to expect. Ava will lead the demo.

Can you confirm the following for us before the session?
- Which environments (staging/prod) will you want Redwood connected to for the initial phase?
- Any network constraints (VPC peering, private endpoints)?
- Who on your side will own the data retention / compliance questions (so we have the right people on the call)

If Tue 9/21 10:00 PT works, I went ahead and created the invite and attached it here (Launchboard_Kickoff.ics). If you prefer Wed 9/22, say so and we’ll swap.

Attendees from our side (confirmed):
- Rishi Malhotra — Customer Success (lead)
- Ava Chen — Solutions Engineer (integration demo)
- Logan Wright — Account Executive
- Markus Klein — Sales Manager (contract/procurement escalation point)

[Attachment: Launchboard_Kickoff.ics]

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
